activities.title: A Visit to the Gurudwara – Celebrating Gurupurab
activities.description: To mark the auspicious occasion of Gurupurab, the students of Balvatika 1 and Balvatika 2 visited a Gurudwara. The visit provided children with an opportunity to learn about the teachings of Guru Nanak Dev Ji, understand the importance of prayer, kindness, equality and sharing, and experience the peaceful atmosphere of the Gurudwara. It was a meaningful learning experience that helped instil values of respect, love and compassion in our young learners.

activities.title: Animal Face Mask Parade – I Care for Animals
activities.description: As an extension of the English textbook story "A Fun Day" under the theme "I Care for Animals," students participated in an Animal Face Mask Activity that integrated Art with Literature. Children created and wore colourful animal face masks, spoke about their chosen animals, and shared simple ways to care for them. The activity encouraged creativity, imagination, self-expression, and confidence while reinforcing the values of kindness, empathy, and compassion towards animals. It made learning joyful, interactive, and meaningful by connecting the story with hands-on artistic expression.
